_method: Values read by a human from the committed page payloads in data/payloads/. Where the page states a price under an explicit selling-price marker (Amazon 'In Stock ... $X', Walmart 'Current price is USD$X', Best Buy the buybox figure, Target the headline price, Newegg the item price), that figure is the truth. Protection plans, comparison tables, sponsored rows, financing instalments and struck-through 'was' prices are not. Extended 2026-09-01 from 25 rows to all 41, so every page in the frozen list is adjudicated. Rows whose committed payload is empty or partial are recorded as null with the reason, rather than guessed. Corrected 2026-09-02: five prices were adjudicated from payloads captured 2026-08-31 and had moved by the time the runs executed. Each was re-checked against a page capture from the run window and corrected; the superseded value appears zero times in those captures. This raises every arm's price score, not one arm's.
